acceptance.offline: Quantify observed pan/tilt bands and graph continuity.
acceptance.physical: Deferred: two bands with three views and one vertical connection require a working verified video acquisition path.

outcome: E9P3 used visual-arrival gates and proved baseline-to-pan, baseline-to-tilt and tilt-to-pan in one execution, with both AbsoluteMove returns optically within 3 px. E9P1/P2 remain retained as evidence that fixed post-command quiet windows are insufficient for delayed tilt video.

scope.input: E9P1, E9P2 and E9P3 scalar reports from Garagem/profile_1
